meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 它把仓库里成堆的 issue 按根因归成少量 plan-master,子 issue 用固定评论重定向后关闭,并产出 plans/0X-*.md 设计文档和一次关闭整组的 PR。
howto.when: 当仓库积累 20+ 个 issue 且多为同源重复,或你要求 triage、consolidate、聚类去重等整理,或想发一个 PR 解决一组相关 issue 时接管。

say.text: 把这批 open issue 按根因聚成几个 plan-master
say.note: 先读完全部正文与评论,再开 master

say.text: 这个新 bug 属于哪个已有 plan?
say.note: 匹配现有 master 并追加 Round 评论

say.text: 帮我发一个 PR,原子关闭 plan-02 的全部子 issue
say.note: 生成带 Closes #N 的 PR

howto.what_en: It groups a repo's pile of open issues by root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes each child with a fixed redirect comment, and writes plans/0X-*.md design docs plus a PR that closes a whole cluster at once.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a tracker has 20+ issues that look like same-root duplicates, when you ask to triage, consolidate, or dedupe issues, or when you want one PR to resolve a related group.

say_en.text: Cluster these open issues by root cause into a few plan-masters.
say_en.note: Reads all issue bodies and comments first.

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Matches a master and adds a Round-N comment.

say_en.text: Open one PR that atomically closes every child of plan-02.
say_en.note: Generates a PR body with Closes #N.
